name: vsa_demo_dl_3g5_100mhz
comment: single CC, SS/PBCH + PDCCH + 3 PDSCH (QPSK/16QAM/256QAM), 30 kHz SCS, FR1 100 MHz.
The VSA demodulates each physical channel with full 3GPP knowledge; nrdemod sees
one blind allocation and settles on 256QAM for the whole grid, so the EVM is not
comparable. Symbols 0-3 (SSB/PDCCH) read 46-98 %, the rest a flat ~9 %.
Both numbers move with maxSymbols (which part of the frame is covered): 14/28/56/112
carrierOffsetHz: this carrier sits half a subcarrier above the tuned 3.5 GHz centre.
Without it nrdemod reports -14362 Hz. The PUSCH demo needs 0 - it is a property of
the carrier placement, not of NR, so it has to be configured per signal.
Tolerances are set to that observed spread - this case exercises the live COM path,
it is not an EVM parity check.
